name: Lab Notebook
pitch: An evidence-first engineering talk where every claim arrives as a numbered figure and the speaker's red pen does the arguing.

illustration.medium: flat vector styled as a hand-annotated lab notebook diagram on off-white
illustration.line: 2px strokes, ruled-notebook precision with small hand annotation marks
illustration.shapes: simple labeled diagrams, pill tags, rectangles with corner notes, grid-paper alignment
illustration.texture: faint ruled or graph-paper lines in the background
illustration.palette_use: off-white background dominant, near-black ink, one navy blue used for labels and callouts
illustration.avoid: gradients, glossy 3D, playful color, hand-drawn wobble beyond small annotation marks
